source: exec: cat /proc/loadavg; echo ---; free -m; echo ---; df -P /; echo ---; cat /proc/uptime; echo ---; nproc
note: Recorded with node:child_process exec() (timeout 10 s, as the port runs it) inside node:22-alpine, the base image of platform/connectors/Dockerfile and of the Node-RED image alike (busybox free/df/nproc), on a Docker Desktop host (8 cores, 32 GB). Not trimmed: this is the complete stdout. statusCode carries the exit code of the command (0). The disk section is `df -P /`, not the `df -P /data` of the old exec node: in this image /data does not exist, and busybox then prints only the header line (see src/connectors/ops-host.ts).
